jurisdiction: United States brokerage-operations research pilot; state licensing, brokerage supervision, privacy, fair-housing and transaction requirements require local review.
source_frame: Action Model system-map industry slug real_estate; taxonomy reference only, not demand or implementation proof.
scope_note: This record covers supervised listing, lead and transaction coordination. It does not provide legal or financial advice, select or recommend property or financing, determine eligibility, negotiate, make fair-housing decisions, or replace a broker, attorney, lender, or other authorized professional.
summary: Start with administrative listing and transaction coordination: capture supplied facts, route requests, maintain checklists and prepare drafts for review. Follow Up Boss and Propertybase demonstrate that incumbents already advertise lead, listing and deal workflow capabilities; any pilot must measure against the actual brokerage stack and retain licensed-professional authority.

automation_research.finding: DOJ describes the Fair Housing Act as prohibiting discrimination in housing transactions, while CFPB Regulation X governs real-estate settlement-service conduct. Those authorities support a narrow automation boundary around clerical collection, routing, reminders and draft preparation; they do not establish an automation rate or authorize software to decide advertising, access, steering, financing or settlement matters.
automation_research.forecast_note: No independently measured brokerage automation percentage, adoption rate or realized saving is used. Vendor feature pages are capability evidence only, not prevalence or outcome evidence.

modules.capability: Property websites and embeddable listing widgets for publishing supplied property information.
modules.reuse_shape: Version-pinned presentation module fed only by broker-approved listing facts; preserve an approval step and do not infer availability, pricing, accessibility or protected-class targeting.
modules.rights_state: README and GitHub metadata indicate an open-source project; license, content rights and production hardening require route-specific review.
modules.limits: Website/widget capability does not prove MLS permission, listing accuracy, accessibility, fair-housing compliance, syndication rights or secure multi-tenancy.

modules.capability: Open-source property-management workflows for tickets, resident contacts, properties, payment tracking, invoices and a service marketplace.
modules.reuse_shape: Use only as a supervised property/service request and checklist pattern, with SISO-owned identity, permissions and records; never as a ledger, escrow, settlement or advice authority.
modules.rights_state: README and GitHub metadata indicate an open-source project; license, deployment, data protection and production qualification require review.
modules.limits: Property-management features do not prove brokerage, MLS, escrow, accounting, tenant-law, fair-housing or settlement compliance.

modules.capability: General CRM for leads, contacts, sales opportunities, campaigns, cases, custom entities and REST-backed records.
modules.reuse_shape: Use as a read/write coordination record only with broker-approved schemas, audit trail and explicit approval for external communications; no property, financing or fair-housing decisioning.
modules.rights_state: Official README supports open-source/customization claims; edition, license and integration/security route require review before adoption.
modules.limits: Generic CRM capability does not prove MLS synchronization, transaction-law compliance, data accuracy, fair-housing controls or authority to send binding communications.

processes.process: Listing intake, completeness check and broker-approved publication
processes.automation_boundary: Collect supplied listing facts and media, flag missing fields, maintain an approval checklist and prepare a draft listing for review; do not invent facts, set price, choose audience, make accessibility/fair-housing determinations or publish without authorization.
processes.baseline_required: Matched listing volume, completeness and correction rate, human minutes including review/rework/exceptions, actual software spend and operator cost.
processes.metric: Human minutes per accurate, broker-approved published listing, including review, corrections and exceptions
processes.falsifier: Reject if unsupported or discriminatory content is published, a critical field is silently changed, or reviewed human effort does not decrease.
processes.human_authority: Broker or designated authorized staff verifies facts, advertising and fair-housing compliance and approves publication; software does not decide audience, eligibility, steering or lawful treatment.

processes.process: Lead intake, response routing and showing coordination
processes.automation_boundary: Capture inquiries, deduplicate supplied contact details, route by broker-defined rules, send approved scheduling options and track confirmations; do not qualify protected classes, steer, recommend a property, or make an eligibility/financing decision.
processes.baseline_required: Matched inquiry/showing volume, response and confirmation times, misroutes, human minutes including review/rework/exceptions, actual spend and operator cost.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per correctly routed and confirmed showing, including exceptions, reschedules and review
processes.falsifier: Reject if routing or messaging uses protected-class proxies, sends to the wrong person/property, exposes data, or review/rework offsets the time reduction.
processes.human_authority: Brokerage staff retain authority over client communication, property recommendations, access and any fair-housing compliance judgment.

processes.process: Under-contract milestone, document and inspection-request coordination
processes.automation_boundary: Maintain a broker-configured checklist, request missing supplied documents, schedule reminders and prepare a review queue; do not interpret contracts, advise on inspection/financing, calculate settlement amounts or release funds.
processes.baseline_required: Matched transaction volume, on-time milestone rate, missing-document and rework rate, human minutes including review/exceptions, actual spend and operator cost.
processes.metric: Human minutes per on-time, correctly documented broker-approved milestone, including review, rework and exceptions
processes.falsifier: Reject if a deadline, obligation or settlement fact is misrepresented, an unauthorized external write occurs, or net reviewed effort is not lower.
processes.human_authority: Broker, attorney, lender, settlement provider and other authorized parties retain contract, legal, lending, settlement and funds authority; the workflow only coordinates supplied facts and reminders.

processes.process: Post-close handoff, service-request intake and referral follow-up
processes.automation_boundary: Log a client request, route it to the selected authorized provider, prepare a status checklist and record acknowledgement; do not recommend financial/legal products, give advice, alter a contract or make a provider/eligibility decision.
processes.baseline_required: Matched request volume and class, acknowledgement and resolution times, misroute/reopen rate, human minutes including review/rework/exceptions, actual spend and operator cost.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per correctly routed and acknowledged request, with review, exceptions and reopenings counted
processes.falsifier: Reject if a referral is represented as advice or endorsement, a request is misrouted, private data is exposed, or review/rework eliminates the net effort reduction.
processes.human_authority: Client and the selected licensed or otherwise authorized provider decide advice, product, legal and financial matters; brokerage staff approve communications and retain supervision.

observed_business_value.reason: No brokerage baseline, invoices, achieved automation rate, reviewed/reworked effort, operating cost, realized cash saving or eligible-population measurement was verified. Null is not zero.

pilot.design: Within one supervised brokerage, compare matched redacted or synthetic listings, inquiries, showings, transaction milestones and service requests under the incumbent and candidate workflows. Pre-register authority, privacy, fair-housing and rollback conditions before live data.
record: assisted human minutes including review and rework
critical data, authority, privacy and fair-housing errors
reject_if: Human effort including review and rework is not lower than the matched baseline.
Any protected or private data crosses an unauthorized boundary or an unapproved external write occurs.
A listing, route, reminder or extracted field is treated as legal, financial, fair-housing, financing, settlement or other professional advice/decision.
Measured first-year net cash is not positive for a cash-savings offer; capacity gains alone are not cash.

limitations: This is not real-estate, legal, financial, lending, settlement, fair-housing or professional advice, product admission or an industry-wide value forecast.
Brokerage software adoption, prices, MLS permissions, realized savings and outcome prevalence were not independently verified; named offerings are not assumed installed.
State licensing, broker supervision, fair-housing, privacy/security, accessibility, advertising, referral, disclosure, contract and records-retention requirements need local review.
No generic repository is treated as a replacement for an MLS, brokerage CRM, transaction-management, accounting, escrow, lender or settlement system of record.
